clips.end_words: what you need before you ask
clips.caption:
Most prayers never get answered because of how they're said.

Begging, pleading, repeating yourself, "please, please, I'll do anything" — that's not prayer, that's desperation, and desperation doesn't connect. The reason is simple and almost nobody is told it: your Father already knows what you need before you ask.

You're not informing God. You're aligning yourself with what's already been decided.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to actually pray.

#prayer #spirituality #awakening #faith #manifestation #kevintrudeau

clips.start_words: from God or pull from anything
clips.end_words: want or what you're praying for
clips.caption:
You can't pull water from a full beaker into another full beaker. It has to be empty, and it has to sit below.

That's the picture for why some people never receive what they're praying for. They come to God — or the universe, or whatever you call it — still full of themselves, still above it, still certain they know better.

Surrender isn't weakness here. It's the only position water can actually flow into.

clips.start_words: Next, it says, Give us today
clips.end_words: for meeting all my daily needs
clips.caption:
The most famous prayer in the world has a line almost everyone gets wrong.

"Give us this day our daily bread" sounds like a request. In the original language, it isn't one. It's closer to "thank you, God, for meeting all my daily needs" — already happened, already true, said in gratitude instead of asking.

That single shift changes how the whole prayer works. You stop begging for what you don't have and start thanking for what's already yours.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the full breakdown.

#awakening #spirituality #prayer #ancientwisdom #manifestation #kevintrudeau

clips.end_words: your prayer is not going to be heard
clips.caption:
There's a line in the Lord's Prayer that most people say and don't mean.

"Forgive us in the same way we forgive others." Read that again. You're not asking God for mercy — you're asking to be measured by your own standard. And the very next line says it plainly: if you don't forgive them, He doesn't forgive you, and the prayer isn't heard at all.

It's the one condition the whole formula runs on.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the full teaching.

#spirituality #awakening #forgiveness #prayer #innerpeace #kevintrudeau

clips.end_words: it will be done for you
clips.caption:
A fig tree had no fruit. Jesus spoke to it once, and by the next morning it was dead down to the roots.

That's the story most people skip past in the prayer teaching, but it's the whole point. Right after it comes the actual instruction: speak to what stands in your way without doubting in your heart, and it moves.

Not hope. Not wishing. A spoken word, believed completely.

clips.end_words: number one and only reason for my success

Not a technique. A belief, held completely, spoken like it was already done.

Love your enemies. Nobody preaches that one anymore.

Not "an eye for an eye." Not "eventually they'll get what's coming." The actual instruction is give — money, time, compassion, especially to the person who wronged you — and the return isn't equal. It's a hundred to a thousand times what you gave, in this lifetime.
